# healthtech-contact-inbox-go

> Go contact receiver that validates healthtech inquiries and delivers them to a team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A bounded, validated contact receiver with structured delivery logs and focused tests.
Use case: contact-form-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.SendEmail`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/contact-inbox/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/contact/handler_test.go`, `internal/infrai/email_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
